title: Engine-Rules Bundle Manifest
description: Manifest accompanying engine-rules-bundle.tar.gz in a GitHub Release. Downstream consumers (Ellington apps.engine_rules #97, #71 comparator) validate this on ingest.

schema_version.description: Version of the per-rule schema (engine-rules.json shape). Bumped when the rule schema changes.

bundle_version.description: SemVer of this bundle release. Tied to the git tag (engine-rules-vX.Y.Z).

min_consumer_version.description: Minimum sync_plugin_catalogs / consumer code version required to safely ingest this bundle. If consumer is older, sync aborts.

plugin_commit_sha.description: Plugin repo commit SHA the bundle was built from.

built_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the bundle was built.

total_rules.description: Sum of engine_rules across all included books.

masters.description: One entry per master included in the bundle.
